test_item:
DebugAuth sends ON if AuthData is applied and connected target function is relevant for SAMType.
(target function connects while the status is ON; the current status is notified)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
proc:
1. PENDING: X-g SAM AuthData target function connection + trigger
2. Confirm the dauth log after the previous step
$ adb logcat -s dauth
er:
1. PENDING: X-g SAM AuthData target function connection + trigger
2. The adb logcat -s dauth output contains the current status notification
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
